description: Inventing covers how inventions happen: what inventors do and their role in the economy, interviewing an inventor, patents and intellectual property, improving an existing product, designing, prototyping and testing your own invention, and joining clubs or visiting exhibits.
outlineNote: The 2026 update revised the interview requirement (finding and interviewing a local inventor with a buddy). Excerpts showed the topics but not their numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet.
